product.title: Foothills Explorer Tour from Denver

description.text: Enjoy an introductory visit to the Rocky Mountains—and still leave enough time to continue your Denver sightseeing—on this half-day, small-group tour. Meet your guide in the morning, and head out to the foothills to enjoy views of the Great Plains and Lookout Mountain. Stops include Lookout Mountain, Lariat Loop, Golden. Drive historic Lariat Loop, and get a glimpse of historic Golden, home to Coors Brewery. Ideal for visitors basing in Denver who want a guided Front Range experience without coordinating transport, trailheads, or mountain logistics on their own.
